diagnosis: Account has SSO entitlement on a Business plan in ap-south. The ticket reports IdP certificate rotation yesterday, which matches KB-0006: metadata mismatch causes assertion errors. Escalation not required; standard resolution path applies.
reply: I understand users cannot sign in via SSO since this morning, and an assertion error appears. This often happens after an identity provider certificate change if the metadata in our system still references the old certificate. Please re-upload your current IdP metadata in the SSO settings and test with a single account. Once sign-in succeeds for that account, you can safely re-enable sign-in enforcement for all users. If the issue continues after the metadata refresh, let us know and we will investigate further.
